description: RFC 8621 §2.3 defines sortAsTree and filterAsTree as request arguments for Mailbox/query. mailbox.rs neither reads nor implements them. Client sending sortAsTree=true or filterAsTree=true silently gets wrong results: sorted by id string, ancestors not filtered. No error is returned. Affects any client using RFC-defined tree-shaped mailbox navigation.
title: Mailbox/query: sortAsTree/filterAsTree silently ignored
